view_claims.claim: Python 3.12 sqlite3.connect with uri=True accepts a SQLite file URI with mode=ro to open a read-only database connection that rejects writes.
After its first read establishes a snapshot, an explicit SQLite read transaction continues to see that snapshot rather than changes made by another connection until that transaction ends.
Python 3.12 json decoding supplies each object's ordered name/value pairs to object_pairs_hook, permitting a caller to reject duplicate keys before constructing a dictionary.
Python 3.12 json decoding accepts NaN and infinity tokens by default, and parse_constant can reject those tokens while parse_float controls conversion of JSON fractional numbers.
